newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SHARES IN KBB PLUNGE ON PROFIT WARNING.
newsitem.headline: SHARES IN KBB PLUNGE ON PROFIT WARNING.

text.p: Shares in store chain KBB fell 14.00 guilders to 128.00, after the firm said its full-year ordinary net would be significantly lower than the previous financial year.
KBB posted 98.6 million guilders profit from ordinary operations in 1995/96 versus 122.7 million in the previous year.
"The net result from ordinary operations of KBB is expected to lag significantly behind that of last year," the firm said last night.
Earlier this week Vendex said it was to sell-off its 36 percent stake in Koninklijke Bijenkorf Beheer (KBB).
The placement is ecpected to be completed within two weeks, Vendex said last Tuesday.
